gating_scope: median leg only; p95 retained as evidence and NOT gated (its exact binomial upper endpoint at 99 blocks is the candidate sample maximum)
derivation: For each workload, block-level exchangeability permutation of the retained 2026-09-06 A/A sides (99 ABBA blocks per side, identical binaries so the true effect is zero), 4000 permutations, seed 20260918, recomputing the comparator's own median-leg upper bound each time. Budget = ceil(quantile at 1 - 0.05/28) of that null, i.e. a 5% family-wise false-regression rate across the 28-workload matrix. Rule applied mechanically; no workload was adjusted by hand.
source_evidence: /data/tmp/br-zxfz1-aa-evidence-20260918/ (four A/A shard bundles, aa-audit.json, SHA256SUMS.txt, null_study.json)
validation: The reimplementation used to derive these reproduced all 28 recorded median_upper_pct and p95_upper_pct values from aa-audit.json exactly.
power_warning: A budget IS this workload's detection floor at 99 blocks: a regression smaller than its budget cannot be distinguished from measurement noise. Budgets range 4%-85%; the widest workloads have correspondingly weak power and must not be read as tight contracts.
